feed.title: AeroAid · Scholarship directory updates
feed.subtitle: Public directory additions, including closed cycles and unverified leads. Check providers.

entry.title: Fairbanks Morse Defense Dependent Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: Stateline Community Foundation — Amount not published. Biological, step or adopted dependent child of a FULL-TIME Fairbanks Morse Defense employee. Foundation explicitly provides a separate application for applicants outside the Stateline Area, including otherwise eligible NJ applicants. Education: planning FULL-TIME first-year/freshman attendance at a TWO- OR FOUR-YEAR technical school, college or university in the upcoming school year. This describes the institution, not an explicit 24-month enrollment rule or an associate-degree guarantee. No required major or previously completed degree is published. AIM NJ’s 21-month nondegree certificate and school classification require provider confirmation; existing enrollment alone does not establish first-year eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Michael G. Finnegan Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: Stateline Community Foundation — Amount not published. HIGH-SCHOOL SENIOR who has lived in an affordable-housing property for at least TWO YEARS and will attend an accredited college, technical school or university in the fall of high-school graduation. Foundation explicitly accepts out-of-area applicants through a separate application, so NJ is not excluded. Education: accredited technical-school attendance is accepted; no specific degree level, major or previously earned degree is required by the public criteria. Exact AIM NJ certificate approval and qualifying housing documentation should be confirmed in the current application. This is not a general award for students already beyond the high-school-senior stage. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Noah Morris Memorial Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: Stateline Community Foundation — Amount not published. Young person who has EXHIBITED SWINE and is a member of Team Purebred or NJSA. Education: pursuing an AGRICULTURE DEGREE while attending a technical school, junior college or community college; exact degree level is not specified. No previously completed degree requirement or prior-degree exclusion is published. Foundation explicitly provides a separate application for out-of-area applicants, including otherwise eligible NJ residents. AIM NJ aircraft-maintenance certificate enrollment does not satisfy the stated agriculture-degree requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: ASME Community College / Technical / Associate Scholarships · 2027–28
entry.summary: ASME Foundation — Varies by matched scholarship. Current ASME student member in good standing pursuing MECHANICAL ENGINEERING, MECHANICAL ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY or general engineering with a mechanical emphasis/closely related discipline at a community college, two-year technical college or associate-degree program. Applications may begin in the first semester of the second year for the following academic year. U.S. students may attend part-time. Minimum 2.5 college GPA with at least one semester transcript; related majors need at least 25% of semester credits in mechanical-engineering, engineering-technology or engineering-AS departments. The U.S. eligibility section requires regional accreditation or ABET; confirm any national-only accreditation against the broader wording elsewhere on the page. Education: qualifying CURRENT engineering-degree study is required, not merely a previously earned degree. Transfer applicants must plan a qualifying engineering program. AIM NJ’s 21-month A&P certificate is not verified as an eligible engineering degree or two-year institution. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Charles Hellier III Scholarship
entry.summary: ASNT Foundation — $10,000. No state exclusion is published; NJ applicants must satisfy the NDT education conditions. Education: enrolled or seeking enrollment in nondestructive testing training at an accredited school or technical training organization. No previously completed degree is required by the detail page. The overview instead describes an NDT associate/certificate program; confirm standalone-course eligibility. AIM NJ’s general 21-month A&P certificate is not expressly approved as NDT training. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: James J. Treat Scholarship
entry.summary: ASNT Foundation — $10,000. No state exclusion is published; NJ applicants must satisfy the NDT education conditions. Education: UNDERGRADUATE students enrolled in NDT education courses at an accredited college or university. No previously earned degree is specified; a past degree does not replace current qualifying enrollment. The overview describes continuing professional training, but detailed college/university enrollment conditions control pending confirmation. AIM NJ nondegree trade-school enrollment is not expressly accepted. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Robert B. Oliver Scholarship
entry.summary: ASNT Foundation — $2,500. No state exclusion is published; NJ applicants must satisfy the NDT education conditions. Education: officially enrolled in an ASSOCIATE DEGREE OR CERTIFICATE program that includes NDT studies. No previously completed degree is required and no prior-degree exclusion is published. Confirm whether AIM NJ’s specific NDT coursework within its 21-month A&P certificate meets this condition; general aircraft-maintenance enrollment alone is not verified approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: OffroadXperts.com Mechanics Scholarship
entry.summary: Offroad Xperts LLC — $500. High-school vocational, trade/technical-school or associate-degree students pursuing mechanics, vehicle repair or fabrication. Sponsor lists automotive, diesel, welding/metal fabrication and powertrain programs. Accredited U.S. school required; no NJ exclusion is published. Education: trade study is accepted without a previously earned degree; no prior-degree exclusion is published. Aircraft maintenance is not named by the sponsor, so AIM NJ acceptance requires confirmation. Bold requires age 14+ and parent/guardian consent under 18. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: WRISE / GRID Renewable Energy Fellowship
entry.summary: Women of Renewable Industries and Sustainable Energy / GRID Alternatives — Conference registration, travel, lodging and onsite expense card; value unpublished. Age 18+, located in the United States during the fellowship, including NJ. All genders welcome. Education: current student or recent graduate of a college, university or technical CERTIFICATE program, including graduate and installer training. No specific previously earned degree is required. Must not yet work in the industry and must plan a U.S. renewable-energy career; solar interest particularly relevant. Current GRID SolarCorps Fellows excluded. AIM NJ aviation-maintenance study alone does not establish clean-energy career fit. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: APWU Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: American Postal Workers Union, AFL-CIO — Up to $3,000 for up to three years of study. HIGH-SCHOOL SENIORS ONLY: child or grandchild, including stepchild or legally adopted child, of a qualifying active, retired or deceased APWU member in good standing. NJ is explicitly included in the regional rules. Excludes national officers’ children/grandchildren, sponsors who are postal managers, and other postal unions. Education: accredited community-college, vocational-school or vocational-program study; eligible training lasts nine months to three years. No previously completed college degree is required. Specific major and prior-degree exclusions are not otherwise published. This is not a current AIM-student award. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SVC Foundation Industry Scholarship
entry.summary: Society of Vacuum Coaters Foundation — Generally $2,500; individual awards may vary. For people already working in vacuum coating technology, including industry operators. No state restriction is published; qualifying NJ workers may apply. Education: supports further classes, books, fees and relevant conference travel. No specific previously completed degree or major is required in the application. The sponsor expressly says this is NOT intended for current students; current AIM NJ certificate enrollment is not an accepted student-funding route under these terms. At least one employer recommendation is required, preferably from a supervisor or HR. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SVC Foundation Academic Scholarships
entry.summary: Society of Vacuum Coaters Foundation — Generally $1,000–$5,000; awards may vary. Full-time students during the award semesters at an accredited technical, vocational, two-year, undergraduate or graduate institution, studying a field related to VACUUM COATING TECHNOLOGY. NJ students are not excluded by the published geographic rules; non-U.S. students are addressed in the foundation’s awarding policy. Education: technical/vocational study is explicitly eligible, with preference for engineering, physics, materials science and related vacuum-coating fields. No previously completed degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ’s 21-month certificate alone does not establish the required subject fit; aviation maintenance is not expressly named. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Worthy Women’s Professional Studies Scholarship
entry.summary: Worthy, Inc. — Three awards: $2,500, $1,500 and $1,000. Women age 30 or older who are permanent residents of the United States and currently enrolled in a continuing education professional studies program. NJ residence is within the published U.S. scope. Education: no specific previously completed degree, required major or prior-degree exclusion is published. The form asks about accredited-college enrollment, major and degree level; it does not expressly confirm nondegree Part 147 certificates. Confirm that AIM NJ’s 21-month program satisfies professional-studies enrollment before relying on this award. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Modern Woodmen Scholarship — members 21 and up
entry.summary: Modern Woodmen of America / Scholarship America — $1,000. High-school graduate/equivalent; beneficial member covered by qualifying Modern Woodmen life insurance or an annuity for at least one year by January 1, 2027, kept active through August payment. Education: accredited vocational/technical certification or degree study qualifies; no particular major or previously earned college degree is required, and graduate study is allowed. Full- or part-time upcoming-term enrollment; part-time means at least 6 credits/term. Prior recipients of ANY Modern Woodmen scholarship, employees and specified current/retired field representatives are excluded; family members may apply. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Modern Woodmen High School Senior Scholarship — two tracks
entry.summary: Modern Woodmen of America / Scholarship America — $1,000–$10,000. High-school seniors graduating January 1–August 31, 2027, with 40 volunteer hours in the preceding two years. Qualifying Modern Woodmen beneficial membership for one year by January 1; insurance/annuity must remain active through August payment. Education: full-time undergraduate study at an accredited college/university OR vocational-technical school for the entire upcoming academic year. No completed college degree or particular major required; intended for incoming students, not ordinary current AIM enrollment. Track 1 GPA 3.5; Track 2 GPA 2.5. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: New Jersey Hall of Fame Areté Scholarship
entry.summary: New Jersey Hall of Fame / ADP — Four scholarships; individual amount unpublished. New Jersey high-school seniors graduating in 2027 who demonstrate academic engagement, moral character, community commitment and perseverance. Education: college OR trade-school plans expressly qualify; no particular major or completed college degree is required. This is an incoming-student route, not a general award for currently enrolled AIM students. Numerical GPA threshold and prior-degree exclusions are not published. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: ReMA PSI Scholarships — employee dependents
entry.summary: ReMA Paper Stock Industries Chapter / RERF — $2,500 scholarships and one $5,000 grand award. High-school senior, minimum C+ average, dependent of a parent/legal guardian employed by a current active/consumer/associate PSI member company in specified recycling, recycled-material mill or procurement/sales/collection work. Dependents of owners/principals are excluded. Employment must continue until award notification. Education: admission to a REGIONALLY ACCREDITED college or trade/vocational program; no completed college degree or fixed major required. AIM’s institutional accreditation must not be assumed to satisfy regional accreditation. Incoming-student route; any eligible institution may be chosen, including NJ. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Second Act Foundation Career-Change Grant
entry.summary: The Second Act Foundation — $500 currently advertised. US-based women/female or femme-identifying applicants age 30+, including the nonbinary/gender-nonconforming people described by the sponsor, with financial need and a current/recent/intended career shift toward STE(A)M. Education: aid may support education, certification or another concrete career-transition expense; no current degree enrollment, completed degree or particular degree major is required in published rules. Prior-degree holders are not excluded. Family of officers/directors/major contributors/selection committee is excluded. AIM and FAA-specific expenses are not expressly confirmed; establish the career-shift fit. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: City Barbeque Employee/Dependent Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: The Columbus Foundation / City Barbeque — Five scholarships of $3,000 under published terms. Employees or dependent children of an employee with at least two consecutive years of full- or part-time City Barbeque employment by the deadline. Education: graduating high-school seniors or students in an accredited U.S. career/technical, two-/four-year or graduate program, full- or part-time. No specific completed degree or major is required for the career/technical route; prior-degree holders are not excluded in the published summary. Exact dependent definition and AIM certificate acceptance need current-cycle confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: ReMA New Jersey Impact Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: ReMA New Jersey Chapter — Two $2,000 scholarships in closed 2026 round. Employee, spouse or dependent of a full-time employee receiving full-time pay/benefits at an active ReMA NJ chapter member firm in good standing at award date. Education: accredited certificate/degree program at a U.S. Department of Education-listed institution. No completed college degree, specified major or prior-degree exclusion published; AIM certificate/program approval and fall/spring payment arrangements need confirmation. Must complete a full school year or return funds. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Delta Zeta Continuing Education and Certification Grant
entry.summary: Delta Zeta Foundation — Up to 75% of program costs; $1,000 lifetime maximum. Initiated Delta Zeta members in good standing who have COMPLETED nondegree professional-development training, certification, licensure or an exam. The sponsor describes this as an alumnae grant for career advancement, career change or return to work. Education: traditional degree-program expenses are outside this grant; no specific previously earned degree or major is required in the published grant rules. Prior degree holders are not excluded. Apply within 90 days AFTER completion, with proof of completion and a current resume. AIM NJ tuition and FAA-specific licensing costs are not expressly confirmed; check the proposed training or exam before relying on this funding. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PACIM Polanie Legacy Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: Polish American Cultural Institute of Minnesota — Up to $2,000 in the closed 2026 cycle. Students of Polish descent enrolled or admitted to a postsecondary institution by September 1 under the published cycle rules. Technical and vocational schools are expressly eligible; no completed college degree, specific major or prior-degree exclusion is stated. Minnesota/Wisconsin residents and PACIM members receive PREFERENCE, not an exclusive residence rule. NJ applicants can check this route. Recipients are expected to volunteer at one PACIM event, either in person or REMOTELY. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Blue Umbrella Waterproofing & Foundations Scholarship
entry.summary: Blue Umbrella Waterproofing & Foundations — $500 per recipient. U.S. students age 16+ with Fall 2027 enrollment at an accredited college, university or vocational/trade school in an approved field. Fields include building technology/services, electrical, engineering technology, manufacturing, HVAC, plumbing, renewable energy, business/accounting/finance, design and related named fields. Education: degree or certificate study is accepted; no completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ aircraft-maintenance study is not specifically listed and needs field confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: John D. Unangst Memorial Scholarship
entry.summary: Franklin Mint Federal Credit Union Foundation — $4,500. Graduating high school seniors planning full-time study at an accredited two-/four-year college, university, trade, technical or business school. NJ residence must be in CAMDEN, GLOUCESTER or SALEM County; eligible PA counties are Delaware, Chester, Montgomery, Philadelphia and Bucks; eligible DE county is New Castle. Education: trade/technical study is accepted without a published associate-degree requirement or named major. No completed college degree is required; other prior-degree rules are not published. Current AIM enrollment alone does not satisfy graduating-senior status. Sponsor/affiliate employees, volunteers and immediate family are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: WFFC Flavor, Fragrance and She Works Scholarships
entry.summary: Women in Flavor & Fragrance Commerce — $5,000 per named scholarship. Women legally resident in the United States/DC, enrolled or accepted at an accredited postsecondary institution in a program specifically related to the FLAVOR OR FRAGRANCE INDUSTRY. Named fields include chemistry, biology, engineering, business, marketing, nutrition, food science, microbiology and cosmetics/fragrance marketing. The She Works route additionally requires employment in that industry while earning the relevant degree or CERTIFICATE. No previously completed degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. General aircraft-maintenance/AIM study is not confirmed for this industry-specific funding. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SC&RF Vocational / Technical and Partner Training Scholarships
entry.summary: Specialized Carriers & Rigging Foundation — $250–$5,000 tuition support; partner training seats also available. For people working in, or preparing for, crane, rigging or specialized transportation careers. SC&RA membership and current industry employment are not required. Education: vocational training, certification and continuing-education courses from one day to several semesters; examples include diesel mechanics and welding. Four-year and master degree students use a different award. No previously completed degree requirement or exclusion is published. AIM aviation-maintenance study is not specifically confirmed for this industry-focused award. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Employee Ownership Foundation Trustee Scholars
entry.summary: Employee Ownership Foundation — $5,000 per year; renewal conditions apply. Detailed rules: age 22 or younger on February 12, 2027; employee or dependent child/stepchild of an employee at a corporate member of The ESOP Association in good standing. Part-time employees and employees not vested in the ESOP may qualify. Education: full-time study for the upcoming academic year at an accredited college or vocational-technical school. Certificates must last at least one semester/term, run on a STANDARD ACADEMIC SEMESTER calendar, and include enrollment when funds are disbursed in August. AIM NJ uses a 21-month academic program; its block calendar requires provider confirmation and is outside confirmed AIM matches. Graduate study excluded; prior-bachelor eligibility needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PTDA Foundation Employee Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: PTDA Foundation — $2,500 in the closed 2026 cycle. Full-time employee of a North American power transmission/motion control distributor or manufacturer. Education: enrolled or accepted at a trade/technical school, college, university, continuing-education or relevant certification program in industry-related engineering, technology or business. No completed degree is required in the public description; no prior-degree exclusion is published. Aircraft-maintenance certificate relevance needs confirmation; current industry employment is mandatory. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PTDA Foundation Student Scholarship — reopening watch
entry.summary: PTDA Foundation — $3,000 in the closed 2026 cycle. Enrolled or accepted trade/technical school, community college or university student in power transmission/motion control-related study, such as industrial engineering, distribution/manufacturing or mechatronics. Education: industry-relevant certifications, associate or undergraduate degrees; graduate study excluded. No completed degree is required; other prior-degree exclusions are not published. Current PT/MC industry employees are ineligible and should check the separate Employee Scholarship. AIM NJ aviation-maintenance certificate relevance needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Wings Over America Navy Aviation Family Scholarships
entry.summary: Wings Over America Scholarship Foundation — $5,000; administered awards vary. Spouse, unmarried child or unmarried grandchild of qualifying U.S. Navy aviation personnel. Standard sponsor rule: eight years of qualifying active-duty/activated-reserve Navy aviation service; flight school does not count. Active-duty deaths in Navy aviation and certain command-specific administered awards have exceptions. Children and grandchildren must be age 23 or younger in the application year and study full-time (at least 12 credits per semester); spouses may study full- or part-time (at least 6 credits). Education: accredited trade/technical certification programs and college degrees are accepted. No completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is stated. AIM NJ certificate students must document the required enrollment load and sponsor relationship. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: APIQWTC Certificate and Degree Scholarship
entry.summary: Asian Pacific Islander Queer Women & Transgender Community — $3,500 per recipient. Asian/Pacific Islander lesbian, bisexual or queer women, or Asian/Pacific Islander transgender or nonbinary individuals. Past recipients of either APIQWTC award are ineligible. Full- and part-time students and returning learners may apply. A San Francisco Bay Area connection is not required. Education: current or prospective Summer/Fall 2027 enrollment in a tuition-based certificate, associate, bachelor or graduate program at a U.S. NONPROFIT institution. No previously completed degree is required; no prior-degree exclusion is published. The nonprofit-school requirement excludes AIM NJ from confirmed matches. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Terri Higa Memorial Technical / Trade Scholarship
entry.summary: Asian Pacific Islander Queer Women & Transgender Community — $3,500. Asian/Pacific Islander lesbian, bisexual or queer women, or Asian/Pacific Islander transgender or nonbinary individuals. Past recipients of either APIQWTC award are ineligible. Full- and part-time students and returning learners may apply. A San Francisco Bay Area connection is not required. Education: pursuing an Associate of Science (AS) or Associate of Arts (AA) in a technical or trade career at an accredited U.S. NONPROFIT institution. Examples include automotive technology/collision repair, carpentry and allied health. A previously earned degree does not substitute for current eligible AS/AA study. No prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ nondegree certificate study does not meet the degree and nonprofit-school rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: APIA Scholars Undergraduate Scholarships
entry.summary: APIA Scholars — $2,500 one-time to $20,000 over multiple years. Demonstrated high financial need. Education: full- or part-time DEGREE-SEEKING associate or bachelor enrollment at a U.S. accredited college/university in Fall 2027. Certificate-only vocational enrollment is not eligible. No prior bachelor or higher degree; an associate graduate pursuing a first bachelor may apply. Returning/adult students are welcome. All ethnicities and national origins may apply if the citizenship rule is met; being first-generation is not required. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Chugach Heritage Foundation Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: Chugach Heritage Foundation — Up to $5,750 per calendar year. Original Chugach Alaska Corporation shareholders and direct lineal descendants who are registered in a recognized vocational, certificate or license-based training program. The vocational rules do not list a major, completed degree or Alaska-school requirement. Qualifying applicants should confirm their exact school, start date or term with CHF. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: CIRI Career Technical Education Scholarship
entry.summary: The CIRI Foundation — Up to $9,000 per calendar year. Original Cook Inlet Region, Inc. shareholders or lineal descendants with a high-school diploma or GED, enrolled in technical training at an accredited or recognized institution leading to a certificate, certification or occupational license. Requires a 2.0 term GPA; successfully completed prior vocational coursework can satisfy the published alternative. No completed college degree or specific technical major is required. Confirm individual school and term eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Oris W. and Sylvia M. Dunham Aviation Scholarship
entry.summary: AAAE Foundation — 2027–28 amount unpublished. Current students in aviation-related study at accredited U.S. or Canadian colleges, universities, technical/vocational schools or trade schools. The trade-school wording covers the type of accredited aviation-maintenance certificate offered at AIM NJ. No specific completed degree or AAAE membership is listed. Confirm the new cycle’s enrollment and school rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: GE Aerospace–Reagan Workforce Readiness Scholarship
entry.summary: Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute / GE Aerospace — 2027 amount pending · prior awards up to $20,000. Students graduating high school in 2027 and entering technical education, vocational certification, skilled trades, two-year degrees or other eligible workforce training. Sponsor examples include aerospace, manufacturing and robotics. A completed degree is not required. The sponsor reserves 25% of awards for students from military households. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Burger King Scholars · vocational and employee pathways
entry.summary: Burger King Foundation / Scholarship America — $1,000–$60,000 across program awards. The General Track accepts 2027 graduating seniors or eligible past recipients for continuous full-time study throughout 2027–28 at an accredited school, including vocational-technical schools. The traditional Employee Track accepts qualifying employees, spouses, domestic partners and dependent children for continuous full- or part-time study. The separate enrichment option permits eligible employees or partners to take intermittent or less-than-part-time accredited certification courses. Traditional tracks require GPA 2.0 or equivalent. No specific vocational major is listed. Confirm whether your AIM NJ enrollment category and dates fit a track. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Milliman Opportunity Scholarship · U.S. program
entry.summary: Milliman / Scholarship America — Up to $5,000. U.S. residents who are high-school seniors or current postsecondary undergraduates. Must plan full-time undergraduate spring 2027 study at an accredited school. The detailed rules include vocational-technical schools and require a listed major such as computer science, programming, data science, mathematics or finance. Current graduate study is excluded. Aircraft maintenance is outside the published majors. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Sempra Employee Dependent Scholarship · vocational route
entry.summary: Sempra / Scholarship America — $1,500 for vocational study. Final-year high-school students age 19 or younger who are qualifying dependents or legal wards of regular full-time U.S. employees of Sempra or an eligible affiliate. GPA 3.0, community involvement and full-time study for the upcoming academic year at an accredited institution are required. Vocational-technical schools qualify. No completed degree or specific trade is listed. Sempra Infrastructure US and Mexico, officers and some other employee categories are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Moroccanoil Student Scholarship · cosmetology
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Moroccanoil — $2,500. U.S. citizens age 18 or older currently enrolled in a cosmetology licensure program at an independent school without a product-brand affiliation. Existing cosmetology license holders and continuing education applicants are excluded. The rules require licensure study and no completed academic degree. This is specific to cosmetology. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Green Circle Salons Student Scholarship
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Green Circle Salons — $2,500. Students age 18 or older enrolled in a U.S. or Canadian cosmetology or barbering licensure program. Existing industry license holders and continuing education applicants are excluded. The criteria specify licensure training and no completed academic degree. Aircraft maintenance is outside the field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Joseph L. Weir Memorial Scholarship · beauty trades
entry.summary: Professional Beauty Association / Joseph L. Weir Trust — $500. Current dues-paying PBA student members enrolled in recognized or accredited cosmetology programs, or licensed professional members pursuing eligible continuing education. No completed academic degree is listed. Licensing applies to the professional route. This award serves beauty trades. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Borboleta Pro Path Esthetics Scholarship
entry.summary: Beauty Changes Lives / Borboleta — Up to $1,500. Esthetics students and licensed professionals pursuing lash-artistry education. Prior administrator terms require proof of an eligible U.S. lash program or relevant licensure and exclude prior Beauty Changes Lives scholarship recipients. No completed degree is listed. Confirm the exact requirements on the upcoming form. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: JAN-PRO Your Family First Scholarship · vocational option
entry.summary: JAN-PRO / Scholarship America — Next amount unpublished. Under the last rules, qualifying JAN-PRO unit franchise owners in good standing for a year, their spouses, dependent children or grandchildren can apply. Employees of unit franchisees and regional developers and their listed family or staff cannot. Full- or part-time study at an accredited vocational-technical school qualifies under the education rule. Confirm whether the selected certificate and school meet the next application’s enrollment terms. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Carpenters Council Scholarship · vocational certificate
entry.summary: North Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters — Individual amount unpublished. Members in good standing and eligible dependent children from any council local. A grandchild qualifies only if the member is the legal guardian. Eligible children of members who recently died may apply under the published rule. The accredited program must run in fall 2027. Technical certificate or diploma study must be full-time and last at least six months. A C average and verified union activity are required. Graduate students and students pursuing a second bachelor’s are excluded. Confirm the selected AIM NJ certificate under the council’s final approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Coast Guard Foundation Spouse Grant · Fall 2026
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — $1,000. Civilian spouses of active-duty enlisted Coast Guard members in grades E-1 to E-9 or enlisted Coast Guard Reservists in those grades on active-duty orders of 180 days or more. Current courses, certificates and professional certification study at a nationally or regionally accredited school can qualify, including accredited aviation-maintenance certificate study. No completed degree or named major is required. First degrees, licensure and certifications receive priority, as do spouses of members E-6 and below. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Fallen Heroes Scholarship · college or trade school
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — Up to 100% of eligible education costs. Dependent children of enlisted or commissioned U.S. Coast Guard members who died in operational service. The Foundation explicitly includes higher education at trade schools and lists no specific major or completed degree. Confirm dependent status and your certificate program through the official application. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Coast Guard Foundation Enlisted Education Grant
entry.summary: Coast Guard Foundation — Up to $1,000 reimbursement. Active-duty enlisted personnel in grades E-3 through E-6. Reservists with over 180 days of active-duty orders in the prior 12 months may qualify. The general grant covers qualifying off-duty technical coursework and credentialing without a completed degree or specified major. Applicants must be participating in or have completed qualifying coursework within the last 12 months. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: First Tech | DCU STEM & Skilled Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: First Tech | DCU — $10,000. High-school seniors or current undergraduate or trade-school students planning full-time fall 2027 study in an approved STEM degree, credential or skilled-trade certificate at an accredited U.S. school. Requires GPA 3.5 or the published GED/HSE equivalent. Applicants in both tracks must be credit-union members in good standing. The employee track also requires a parent or legal guardian currently employed by First Tech | DCU. Prior program recipients are excluded under the applicable rules. Standalone AIM NJ A&P certificate eligibility requires confirmation. The FAQ lists some aviation-related majors, with no explicit aircraft-maintenance certificate entry. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Industrial Maintenance Scholarship · employment pathway
entry.summary: ELLWOOD — Up to $20,000 toward tuition. High-school seniors or GED completers who will pursue a certificate, diploma or degree in mechatronics or equivalent industrial maintenance. Recipients must start an approved program by the following January, maintain a 2.5 GPA, have reliable transport and meet employment screening. Published examples are outside NJ. ELLWOOD can approve other schools by written review. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance and any unlisted NJ school need approval. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Cape May Tech Post-Secondary Education Scholarship
entry.summary: Cape May County Chamber of Commerce Education Foundation — Amount unpublished. Cape May County residents enrolled in a post-secondary program at Cape May County Technical School. The current form requires a B or better, 95% attendance and punctuality, and a recommendation from someone outside the family. It lists no completed degree or specific major. The award is restricted to the named school’s post-secondary programs. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: College and Trade School Scholarship · graduating seniors
entry.summary: Cape May County Chamber of Commerce Education Foundation — Amount unpublished. Cape May County residents graduating high school in 2027 with a C average or better and the published attendance and conduct standards. The Foundation requires a qualifying employment or ownership connection to a Cape May County Chamber member business. The application accepts students planning trade school, with no stated completed degree or specific major. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Walter P. Krichling Jr. Vocational Scholarship
entry.summary: New Jersey Retirees’ Education Association — $1,500. 2027 graduates of a New Jersey public high school, including vocational-technical and public charter schools, with GPA 2.3 or higher and admission to a trade or vocational certification program. No completed degree or specific vocational major is listed. This is an entering-student route. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: James F. Anthony Scholarship · college or trade school
entry.summary: Big I New Jersey — $1,000. Dependents of current employees of active Big I New Jersey member agencies. Applicants plan to attend college, university or technical/trade school. The main description names seniors while the eligibility list also names juniors. Confirm school year with the sponsor. No specific trade or completed degree is listed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: BTA Education Scholarships · trade-school route
entry.summary: Business Technology Association — $1,500–$3,000. Full-time employees of a current BTA member dealership, or their children, who study full time. BTA defines full-time employment as at least 30 hours weekly. The school rule lists accredited two- or four-year colleges, universities and technical/trade schools, and requires 12 college credits per semester, or nine for graduate students. No prior degree or particular major is listed. Confirm whether AIM NJ’s 21-month certificate and credit schedule meet those separate requirements. The related Patriot Pack category requires a qualifying veteran employee or their child or grandchild. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Tools for Success Scholarship · construction trades
entry.summary: ShareMyToolbox — Next amount unpublished. High-school seniors, current students and adult career changers enrolled or accepted into construction-related trade school, apprenticeships or degree programs. Applicants need an eligible ShareMyToolbox Business or Enterprise customer sponsor. No completed degree is required for the trade or apprenticeship route. Aircraft maintenance by itself is outside the construction field requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Career & Technical Education Award
entry.summary: Point Foundation — $2,000. LGBTQ+ students and allies enrolled or planning to enroll in an accredited career certificate or trade program, with at least one credit-bearing class in the funded spring term. AIM NJ’s 21-month, credit-bearing aviation maintenance certificate is the type of nondegree study described. Confirm your term enrollment and individual eligibility. Fully online programs and students currently pursuing an unrelated degree are excluded. No previously earned degree is required. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Educational Award
entry.summary: Catholic Order of Foresters — $600. Existing Catholic Order of Foresters members age 17 or older who attend or plan to attend an accredited college, trade or technical school. The application requires at least 15 months of membership in good standing before applying. Winners must supply proof of registration or attendance. Prior Educational Award or Fraternal Scholarship winners are excluded. Accredited certificate study can qualify without a completed degree or specified major. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Builders League of South Jersey Scholarship
entry.summary: BLSJ Scholarship Foundation — 2027 amount unpublished. Applicants must live or attend school in Atlantic, Burlington, Camden, Cape May, Gloucester, Salem or Cumberland County. Qualified full-time and part-time programs in home building, construction, remodeling or related fields can qualify, including trade school. Past recipients studied carpentry and HVAC. No completed degree is specified for the trade route. The published field is construction rather than aviation maintenance. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Workforce Credentials Scholarship
entry.summary: Council of College and Military Educators — $1,000. Current or former U.S. uniformed service members and eligible spouses or children. Applicants must be enrolled with a CCME member organization in a qualifying DoD SkillBridge program or a credential program validated by the U.S. Department of Labor or a State Apprenticeship Agency. Credit-bearing and nondegree paths are eligible. No completed degree is required for this category. Standalone AIM NJ enrollment does not establish the provider and validation requirements. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Manufacturing and Engineering Scholarships · matched application
entry.summary: SME Education Foundation — $2,500–$20,000. Graduating high-school seniors and students pursuing an associate, bachelor’s or graduate degree in manufacturing, engineering or a technical field that supports manufacturing. Full- and part-time study can qualify. The sponsor lists a 2.0 general minimum GPA, with individual award criteria varying. Applicants need a permanent U.S. or Canadian address. The portal matches students to individual awards, including awards for women. An AIM NJ certificate alone does not satisfy current degree study. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: JAHMA Resident Education Scholarship
entry.summary: JAHMA Foundation — Next amount unpublished. Residents of a participating JAHMA member property, including high-school seniors, graduates, GED holders and older adults. Accredited trade or professional schools are eligible under the prior rules. The sponsor lists no completed college degree or specific major. Document admission and check that your property and school qualify. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Precast Concrete Undergraduate Scholarship · certificate route
entry.summary: NPCA Foundation — $3,500 first year · up to $6,500 after internships. Applicants planning certificate or undergraduate enrollment for the next academic year in building, construction or precast concrete. No completed degree is required for the certificate route. The program must relate to these industries. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance by itself is outside those fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Building Hope Scholarship · construction trades
entry.summary: NAHB Professional Women in Building Council / National Housing Endowment — Next amount unpublished. Full- or part-time fall students at a college, university or trade school in a building-related course or vocational program, with at least one course or program remaining after the award. No completed degree is listed. The sponsor’s Building Hope rules do not list a women-only requirement. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is outside the published field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Cobell Vocational & Trade Scholarship
entry.summary: Indigenous Education, Inc. — Up to $7,500 per calendar year. Enrolled members of a U.S. federally recognized American Indian Tribe or Alaska Native Corporation pursuing a vocational credential, certificate or occupational license at an accredited nonprofit institution. A second credential at the same level is excluded. The nonprofit school requirement excludes AIM NJ’s proprietary certificate. Eligible nonprofit NJ programs can qualify. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.summary: Disabled American Veterans — $2,500–$30,000. Volunteers 21 or younger with at least 100 hours credited through DAV or DAV Auxiliary. Self-nomination is allowed. Accredited vocational schools qualify, including an aviation maintenance certificate program that meets the institution rules. The sponsor lists no specific major, completed degree or degree-enrollment requirement. Applicants do not have to be veterans or dependents. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

This route serves graduating seniors, including those planning trade school. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

The form accepts planned or current vocational/technical certificate, license or degree study. No prior college degree or specific major is listed. Check the senior rule and exact school eligibility before assuming a current AIM NJ match. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.summary: Corvias Foundation — 2027 amount unpublished. Spouses of active-duty service members assigned to one of seven Corvias installations listed by the sponsor. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

Check official terms; not necessarily open.

Current AIM NJ enrollment alone does not satisfy the first-year-after-high-school rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.
